red_flags: Tenant was messaged and asked to resend photos, which was slightly beyond what was needed, but it is harmless and grounded in the note that the photos were unavailable.
No landlord phone number was on record, so the email chase may not reach the landlord. The agent flagged this itself.
reasoning: The case is a routine, non-urgent garden job still waiting on landlord approval after 3 days. The agent chased the landlord by email and asked for approval of a contractor quote visit, which commits no money. It kept the tenant informed, asked for the missing photos and put a hold in place with a follow-up in 3 days. It listed what it could not verify and set out the escalation path. This matches what the human operator did next, which was repeated landlord chasing, a quote and landlord approval. It invented no facts and did not use information from after the decision point. Waiting with a chase is justified, though earlier escalation or a phone call would have been slightly stronger.
